purpose: Define the auditable evidence needed to convert the paper-data candidate into externally evaluated software and a submission-ready empirical claim set without treating author-run paper-data analyses as independent validation.

public_release.commit: resolve with git rev-parse 'v0.1.3-r10.25^{}' and compare with release/empirical_candidate_v0.1.3-r10.25/release_manifest.json

paper_data_evidence_boundary.allowed_primary_route: T195 exact nine-target leave-one-source-anchor-out exploratory route with measurement-batch clustering
allowed_sensitivity_routes: T197 development-only target availability and selection-aware sensitivity
T198 paper-cohort threshold and AUTHOR_NA missingness sensitivity
paper_data_is_not: a biological replication count inferred from measurement batches

required_outputs: effective n by target, cluster and source lineage

acceptable_data_scope: the declared redistributable three-lab common-target route
a declared public paper supplementary workbook or accession route
a declared paper-attached OOD route with its license and unit limits

recommended_public_accession_route.source_role: public author-run OOD route available for no-author reproduction

expected_source_audit.biological_unit_claim: technical condition batches; human donor independence not inferred

reproduction_commands: uv run biointerfaceos data audit-r3-silver-plasma-source --assets-root data/raw/r3_candidate_pmc6592156 --strict

uv run biointerfaceos data evaluate-r3-silver-external-ood --output-data-root data/raw --feature-root data/raw/r3_uniprot_sequence_features --silver-assets-root data/raw/r3_candidate_pmc6592156 --strict
recommended_public_accession_route.author_result_is_not_a_target: The expected counts and author-run result are comparison metadata only; the reproducing team must reacquire and hash the supplementary bytes independently and must report deviations rather than tune to the expected result.

prohibited_actions: fabricating or backfilling an external receipt
using author-controlled reruns as independent evidence
using paper measurement batches as biological replication without unit proof
substituting fixtures for real accession or supplementary data
changing the primary endpoint after external data access
setting scientific_submission_ready true before receipt verification
claim_boundary: This is a handoff and verification contract. Public full-text and accession data can support a transparent author-run paper-data analysis and no-author reproduction, but cannot by themselves create a lockbox evaluation, external adoption or biological replication claim.
